name: pcc-mirror-app
description: Standalone, genuinely separate, read-only 'At a Glance' companion app (Post-Phase-5 Engineering Evolution, 3-app split). Reads the same one-way mirror snapshot src/js/dataMirror.js's Windows write side produces, and renders the real, unmodified Dashboard/MyWork/ActionCentre/Portfolio React page components + their real services from ../react/src — reusing the real domain logic, never forking it (see src/shim/pcc.ts's header for exactly what is real vs. a safe no-op stub). Deliberately excludes every vendor library the main app needs for editing (xlsx, mammoth, pdf.js, jszip, sql.js) and the CPM/import engines, so this app's bundle stays genuinely smaller than index.html's. This directory's own node_modules/esbuild/tsc are dev/packaging-time only, same as react/ and tests/ — the shipped APK never needs Node or npm present. react and react-dom are intentionally NOT devDependencies here: this project reuses the exact single copy already installed at ../react/node_modules via symlinks build.js creates in this directory's own node_modules/, so the two apps' React page components (built from ../react/src, shared unmodified) never end up bundled with two separate React copies.
